summary: Implemented the fullscreen Detail mode: a header toggle (fullscreen/restore) plus a module-scope detailFullscreen flag that fixes the Detail over the canvas and bottom drawers while keeping the toolbar visible; Esc, the toggle, or selecting another card exits; exiting restores the dragged width and the drag handle is inert while fullscreen. The Detail never unmounts, so interrupt forms and live snapshots keep working. Ran the two-axis code review and applied its fixes (rename to canvasHeaderBottom, dedupe toggle label into setFullscreenToggleLabel, clarify CSS comment). 141 engine + 61 UI tests, typecheck, and build all clean.
